title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former Costa Mesa police officer has pleaded guilty to a campaign of harassment against his mistress. He contacted her thousands of times by text message, phone call, and social media, and on at least one day he reached out more than 100 times. He also admitted to illegally using confidential law enforcement databases to track several people in his personal life, including his wife, an ex-girlfriend, and men he considered romantic rivals.

The guilty plea covers both the obsessive contact and the misuse of police records. The former officer now awaits sentencing. The available report does not state the exact date of sentencing or the specific penalties he may receive, but the plea is a formal admission of the conduct described in the charges.
